## Endpoints

### Data Read (2)
- `GET /data/guide.json/{guide.jsonId}` — Retrieve a specific guide's data.
- `GET /data/recordingconf/{recordingconfId}` — Get recording configuration details.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /data/rec/{recId}` — Submit recording data.

### Media (1)
- `GET /themes/custom/cna_theme/files/Skeywords.json` — Retrieve keywords for site content.

### Config (1)
- `GET /api/config.json` — Get the website's configuration settings.

### Core API (1)
- `POST /WRSiteInterceptEngine/Targeting.php` — Submit targeting data to the engine.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Cna's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Cna data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.cna.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Cna frontend uses
